title: DECODE: Decomposable Environments for COntrolled Sequential-Decision Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18367v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a sequential decision system falls short of an optimum, its score does not reveal which modifications would improve its decisions. DECODE is a benchmark for testing such modifications through controlled experiments on planning and available information. Its consumer-credit collections generator provides five partially observed environments that share known dynamics matrices and vary a memory parameter and process noise. The experiments change selected inputs or planning rules while keeping the rest of the solver fixed. Each comparison specifies the solver's state inputs, response inputs and planning horizon. On the deterministic base environment, which was selected for a large gap between six-month and one-month planning with the hidden state, extending planning from one to six months increases the scores of two gradient-boosted solvers by 15 to 17 percentage points of the exact optimum, computed with the hidden state and borrower t

translated_title: DECODE：用于受控序贯决策评估的可分解环境
translated_abstract: 当一个序贯决策系统未能达到最优时，其得分并不能揭示哪些修改能够改进其决策。DECODE 是一个基准测试，用于通过对规划方式和可用信息进行受控实验来检验此类修改。其消费信贷催收生成器提供了五个部分可观测的环境，这些环境共享已知的动力学矩阵，并在记忆参数和过程噪声上有所变化。实验在保持求解器其余部分不变的情况下，改变选定的输入或规划规则，每次比较都明确了求解器的状态输入、响应输入和规划范围。在确定性基础环境中（该环境被选中是因为使用隐藏状态时六个月规划与一个月规划之间存在较大差距），将规划范围从一个月延长到六个月，使两个梯度提升求解器的得分相对精确最优值（基于隐藏状态和借款人信息计算）提高了15到17个百分点。
tldr: 提出了DECODE基准，通过共享已知动力学矩阵、可在记忆与噪声参数上分解控制的消费信贷催收环境，以受控实验方法评估规划范围和信息可用性等修改对序贯决策系统性能的具体影响。
en_tdlr: DECODE is a benchmark of decomposable, partially observed consumer-credit collection environments with shared known dynamics that enables controlled experiments to isolate how planning and information modifications affect sequential decision performance.
